sources.title: BANGLADESH’S CHITTAGONG PORT AUTHORITY AND DP WORLD SIGN 15-YEAR CONCESSION FOR NEW MOORING CONTAINER TERMINAL

quotes.text: The New Mooring Container Terminal will remain under the ownership of the Chittagong Port Authority, with DP World responsible for its operation, and maintenance under the 15-year concession.

sources.title: DP World gets 15-year concession to operate New Mooring Container Terminal | The Business Standard

quotes.text: CPA will receive 67% of the terminal's revenue from each TEU handled, plus a fixed annual fee of about Tk10 crore.
But the precise revenue-sharing formula, including covered income streams and allowable deductions, has not been publicly disclosed.
NCT handled about 13.85 lakh TEUs last fiscal year, accounting for roughly 44% of Chattogram Port's total container handling.
CPA earned Tk6,629 crore in FY26 by handling 3.52 million TEUs.
The government says existing NCT workers will retain their jobs, wages and benefits, with expanded training and career-development opportunities.

sources.title: Ctg Port workers protest DP World's NCT deal, announce hunger strike on 12 Oct | The Business Standard

quotes.text: Workers say they will observe a two-hour hunger strike on 12 October if the government fails to create a path for dialogue over the 15-year concession agreement.

sources.title: CPA, DP World sign deal to boost Chittagong port capacity

quotes.text: In addition, CPA will receive a share of terminal revenue or royalty, ranging from around 40 per cent to 67 per cent per TEU depending on average terminal revenue, along with a fixed annual fee of approximately Tk 100 million.
The agreement provides an upfront payment of around Tk 6 billion, with 25 per cent payable upon signing and the remaining 75 per cent before commencement of operations.
